## Science

We contribute to the understanding of the Arctic as a system component by

- bridging across disciplines and methodological approaches,
- providing results and data through open science,
- contributing to science networks:
  [HiLDEN[]{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://arcticdrones.org){.text-link},
  [AVA[]{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://iasc.info/our-work/working-groups/terrestrial/twg-projects/817-an-arctic-vegetation-archive-ava){.text-link},
  [EU-Charter[]{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://www.charter-arctic.org){.text-link},
  [Geoengineering[]{.bi .bi-link-45deg}](https://iasc.info/our-work/working-groups/cross-cutting-activities/cross-cutting-funded-projects/1129-geoengineering-to-save-the-arctic-assessing-potential-efficacy-impacts-and-ethical-considerations-across-rightholders-stakeholders-and-scientific-disciplines){.text-link},
- teaching across disciplines.

## Society

We aim to

- address societal challenges at the nexus of climate and biodiversity,
- inform society through webinars, panel discussions and newspaper articles.
